conduct.isolation: Every generated file/cache/report/export/locator belongs to YOUR OWN fresh external scratch. Do not write to these supplied inputs or any historical supplied scratch. Do not replay receipt argv or historical controller scripts. Any isolation breach is BLOCKED and disclosed, not cleaned/restored away.

conduct.authority_json: Do not dump whole authority.json or old review directories. Extract current top-level branch/current_scope/product_code_authority/active_council_roster and document_ingestion_remediation fields. Historical other-unit scores/verdicts are not review evidence.
conduct.commands: After verifying/inspecting wrapper, ALL Git commands, repository administration and any subprocess that invokes Git/admin MUST execute via python3 -B INPUTS/read_only_command.py YOUR_OWN_FRESH_SCRATCH -- COMMAND ARGS. This forces GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and private caches/TMPDIR, logging exact argv/env/exits. No bare Git including check-ignore. Repository admin UV commands remain offline/frozen/no-sync/no-download. Static read-only pathlib/ast/sed/rg/cat/wc/hash commands over permitted source/inputs or own scratch, and own report writes/hash, may run without this wrapper because they invoke no Git/admin; Python uses -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Do not import product modules or read personal state. Optional-lock environment is not a condition on plain cat/wc. Classify command categories honestly in audit; do not claim all processes were wrapped when exempt reads were not.
conduct.diff_isolation: Read the correction diff only using explicit changed technical/current-status paths. For aggregate, filter to REM, companion, iteration authority/correction brief, current status and source pins. Do not run an unfiltered c36..HEAD diff or open prior council reports/history; those contain peer text. Authority JSON: extract current fields only.
conduct.violations: Isolation/private-write/repository read-only violations, or an unwrapped Git/admin invocation/child with unestablished required Git environment, are BLOCKED and disclosed; later matching integrity does not erase them. Exempt plain source/scratch reads and own-report operations described above are permitted. Previous round3 procedural BLOCKED remains unchanged under its own broader request; this is a future-only precision correction, not a waiver or retroactive score change.

The immutable integrity helper is solely authorized to hash pinned protected files and stat the six metadata records. Source establishes maintained paths; personal data is unnecessary.
conduct.bounded_output: Read the complete request through bounded field/page output rather than dumping the whole JSON or prior authority history. Avoid unnecessary giant outputs/harness archives. This is separate from correctly preserving your own outputs in fresh scratch.
conduct.after_audit: Closing integrity follows the last shared repository/input inspection. Additional shared repo/Git/admin inspection requires repeating closing integrity through wrapper. No cleanup or mutation.
